title: WWII Soldier POV: El Alamein — Through the Minefields
hook: The desert is silent. Then hundreds of guns open fire at once.
shortDescription: Experience the Second Battle of El Alamein from the first-person perspective of a fictional British Eighth Army infantry soldier. Cinematic historical reenactment, not archival footage.
longDescription: Step into an immersive first-person historical reenactment of the Second Battle of El Alamein, fought in Egypt from October 23 to November 4, 1942. This episode follows a fictional composite British Eighth Army infantry soldier from the opening artillery barrage, through marked minefield lanes and forward desert positions, to the eventual Allied breakthrough. AI-generated cinematic reenactment, not real wartime footage.
